name: "Default Encryption" policies MUST be enabled on all Storage Accounts/S3/Blob storage to ensure sensitive data is not accidentally stored without protection.
conditionsText:
This obligation is relevant if your service:
- Stores files, documents, backups, logs, or databases in cloud storage.
- Uses Azure Storage Accounts, Blob Storage, AWS S3, or similar services.
- Handles personal, sensitive, financial, or business-critical data.
Cloud storage services:
Blob Storage - Azure
S3 buckets - AWS (Amazon web services) and similar cloud storage solutions
requirementTitle: "Default Encryption" policies MUST be enabled on all Storage Accounts/S3/Blob storage to ensure sensitive data is not accidentally stored without protection.
requirementDescription: Encryption must be turned on by default for all cloud storage services so that any data saved there is automatically protected, even if someone forgets to configure encryption manually.
why: Its a security control that reduces the impact of a beach and protects against misconfigured storage, unauthorised access, insider threats and cloud account compromise
